text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've come to the track to watch a
race. It
looks like Kitasan Black is going
to be
competing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I don't suppose you've seen
Kita by
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She still hasn't arrived at the racetrack.
The staff
members are looking for her
too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I should never have arranged to meet
her at the racecourse... What if
something happened to her
on her way
here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll come too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes... You're right...
choice_data_list: Don't you still have your races?
You still have your races, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond stays behind as I head
off to
search for Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're almost there! Don't give up now!
One more
time! Heave-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Kitasan Black on the riverbank.
She's
holding a rope, and at the end of
it is a truck
that's submerged in the river.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... We just need to pull a little more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Already?!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're competing?! You'd better
get
yourself over there fast!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can manage this by ourselves.
Get
going!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way! Didn't you say you have to
deliver the
stuff in this truck within the
hour?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just let me help a little longer!
I'll make
it to the
race before it starts, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Thanks so much! Okay, time to
pull!
choice_data_list: Understood. I'll let you know when...
Understood. I'll tell you when it'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how hard they try, the
truck stuck
in the muddy riverbed
doesn't budge...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Can't... give up... We're so... close!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No way... Can it really end like this?!
...me help...
Let me help too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to explain! I just have to
grab
here and pull, right?!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Another Umamusume? We might just be
able to
do this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's bound to budge this time! Here we
go,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the immense strength of the two

Umamusume, the tires begin to roll, and
we
finally pull the truck out!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Looks like I'll be able to make
my
delivery on time after all! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all. We're all here to help
each
other out! That's what my dad
always says!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We really did it, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, Dia. I didn't mean to
make
trouble for you right before our
race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's not like you're the only one.
I caused
you all
kinds of hassle when I was sick.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
I'd miss you if you weren't in the
race. I
want to run with you too, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're not the only one who was looking
forward
to today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's go all out!
It's a race for first
place
between me and you, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair start running beneath the blue
sky. They've overcome disaster, and
now—with their sights set on the
track—they vow to race with all they've
got.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks. You really saved the day, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, I figured you must have
gotten
yourself mixed up in something!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that goes for you too! And you still
have
your racewear on, even!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just couldn't sit around knowing
you might
be in trouble, could I?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I suppose we really are pretty
similar,
aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep. If you're ever in a bind, you know
I'll come
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After making a vow of firm friendship,
the two sprint off. What kind of race will
they put on? My
heart races with
anticipation.
